title: Stop service over valid SendRRData
purpose: Provide a structurally valid Stop service request carried by SendRRData to cover a neighboring CIP common service code with the same transport skeleton.
expected_behavior: The target should parse the valid SendRRData and CPF wrapper and then process or reject the Stop service request at the CIP layer.
constraints_preserved: Outer framing preserves the 24-byte encapsulation header.
Length is 0x0018, matching the 24-byte command-specific payload.
Command-specific data includes interface handle and timeout before CPF.
CPF order is item_count, Null Address Item, then Unconnected Data Item.
Service code 0x07 is the documented Stop service.
Path-size byte 0x02 matches the included path words.
issue_safety_notes: This is a valid service-bearing seed, not a malformed negative test.
